prompt: Create a premium contemporary mixed-media editorial collage portrait of a young male traveler standing in a peaceful open posture with both arms extended wide. Show him from the waist up, facing left in profile, chin lifted toward the sky, eyes hidden behind dark sunglasses, expressing liberation, gratitude, hope, and inner peace. He has medium-tan skin, a short beard, loose dark hair tied in a small messy bun, and wears a gray knitted beanie, a thick gray scarf, and a light cream-white travel jacket with soft folds. Use a vertical portrait canvas with generous cream parchment-like negative space and a refined magazine-cover composition. Behind his head place one large weathered orange sun disk filled with subtle cloudy sky texture. On the right side of the sun, include exactly 1 large flying eagle and exactly 5 tiny distant bird silhouettes. Blend the lower half of the traveler into a double-exposure landscape: exactly 1 acacia-like tree centered in the lower torso area, reflective water beneath it, distant mountains, warm sunset clouds, and orange-gold light. Surround the figure and landscape with translucent layered rectangles, faint architectural grid lines, ink splatters, grunge brush textures, paper scratches, and semi-transparent beige, gray, charcoal, and burnt-orange collage blocks. The style should feel like a high-end travel editorial poster combining photorealistic portraiture, painterly textures, double exposure, and abstract geometric collage. Use warm earthy tones: burnt orange, cream, taupe, gray, charcoal, and soft sunset gold. No text, no logo, no watermark, no border; keep the subject crisp while the collage edges fade organically into the background.

promptZh: 创作一张高级当代混合媒介编辑风格的拼贴肖像，主角为 一位年轻的男性旅行者，他以宁静开放的姿态站立，双臂向两侧伸展。画面展示其腰部以上，侧身向左，下巴微抬望向天空，双眼被深色墨镜遮住，流露出自由、感恩、希望与内心平静。他拥有中等肤色、短胡须，深色长发扎成凌乱的小发髻，戴着灰色针织帽、厚实的灰色围巾，身穿带有柔和褶皱的米白色旅行夹克。使用垂直肖像画布，留出充足的米色羊皮纸质感负空间，采用精致的杂志封面构图。在他头部后方放置一个巨大的风化橙色太阳圆盘，内部填充细腻的云层纹理。在太阳右侧，包含 1 只巨大的飞鹰和 5 只微小的远方鸟类剪影。将旅行者的下半身融入双重曝光景观中：躯干下方中心位置为 1 棵金合欢树，下方有倒影水面、远山、温暖的日落云彩及橙金色光芒。在人物和景观周围点缀半透明的层叠矩形、淡淡的建筑网格线、墨迹飞溅、污渍笔触、纸张划痕，以及半透明的米色、灰色、炭灰色和焦橙色拼贴块。整体风格应呈现出高端旅行编辑海报的质感，结合写实肖像、绘画纹理、双重曝光和抽象几何拼贴。使用温暖的大地色调：焦橙色、米色、灰褐色、灰色、炭灰色和柔和的日落金色。无文字、无 Logo、无水印、无边框；保持主体清晰，同时让拼贴边缘自然地融入背景。
